items.title: Walter Booker and Jimmy Cobb interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: They have been the propelling force behind some of the greatest jazz soloists, including Miles Davis, Cannonball Adderley, Dinah Washington and Dizzy Gillespie.

ctx.x: Bassist Walter Booker and drummer Jimmy Cobb, currently working with the Nat Adderley Quintet, make up one of the finest rhythm teams in jazz today.
They have been the propelling force behind some of the greatest jazz soloists, including Miles Davis, Cannonball Adderley, Dinah Washington and Dizzy Gillespie.
Walter and Jimmy were interviewed by Michael Woods on a Royal Caribbean
